# Nuraan Perfumes

> Artisanal Concentrated Perfume Oils & Pure Attars | 100% Alcohol-Free | Handcrafted in India

Nuraan Perfumes is an Indian luxury artisanal perfumery house specializing in 100% alcohol-free, extrait-strength concentrated perfume oils (attars) housed in 12ml precision stainless-steel roll-on bottles and 3ml curated discovery boxes.

- **Website**: https://nuraanperfumes.in/
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 85910 59608 (https://wa.me/918591059608)
- **Instagram**: @nuraan_perfumes (https://www.instagram.com/nuraan_perfumes)
- **Location**: Mumbai, India
- **Shipping**: Free express courier dispatch across all PIN codes in India

---

## Core Brand Pillars

1. **100% Alcohol-Free**: Formulated solely from pure perfume oil extracts, natural resins, and rare woods. Zero alcohol sting, zero evaporation loss, skin-safe.
2. **14+ Hours Longevity**: Pure oils bond directly with pulse-point lipids, projecting sillage for 14 to 24+ hours on skin and up to 48 hours on natural fabric.
3. **12ml Precision Roll-On Single Bottles**: Fitted with smooth stainless-steel rollerballs for effortless, spill-free application on pulse points.
4. **Direct Designer Alternative Benchmarks**: Nuraan crafts accessible, pure-oil renditions of world-renowned luxury fragrances (e.g. Baccarat Rouge 540, Creed Aventus, YSL Black Opium, Dunhill Icon) at a fraction of their designer retail price (saving shoppers 70% to 97%).

---

## Discovery Boxes & Coffret Sets

- **French Discovery Box**: 6 × 3ml precision roll-on travel vials featuring top French Collection picks. Price: ₹1,299 (MRP ₹3,299).
- **Arabic Discovery Box**: 6 × 3ml precision roll-on travel vials of traditional Arabian attars. Price: ₹1,399 (MRP ₹3,299).
- **Women's Discovery Box**: 6 × 3ml floral, gourmand, and sweet nectar roll-ons. Price: ₹1,299 (MRP ₹3,299).
- **Oud Discovery Box**: 6 × 3ml rare agarwood and oriental blends. Price: ₹1,399 (MRP ₹3,599).
- **Custom "Build Your Own" Box**: Shoppers can handpick any 6 fragrances from the entire catalog.

## How to Order

Customers can order directly via:
1. **WhatsApp Instant Checkout**: Click any "Order on WhatsApp" button on https://nuraanperfumes.in/ or message +91 85910 59608 with chosen scents.
2. **Instagram Concierge**: DM @nuraan_perfumes for personalized scent recommendations and order placement.
3. **Multi-Item Order List**: Add multiple single bottles and discovery sets to the interactive order drawer and dispatch the complete list in a single click to WhatsApp.
